name: Space Bunny
short: Undisclosed vendor's stealth reasoning model (1M context, 524K out) for free single-shot code gen and agents; one model as Space Bunny/Alpha/Free tier, Zen free live, OpenRouter ended.
pricingNote: Free on OpenCode Zen for a limited time; zero-retention provider, no training on your data
freeTierNote: Stealth model free during limited preview on OpenCode Zen (ID space-bunny-free); provider follows a zero-retention policy and does not use your data for training.
standout: Exceptional at single-shot creative work — most notably SVG art and self-contained code generation — straight from a free, zero-retention endpoint.
tradeoff: The vendor and provenance are undisclosed, and the wider benchmarks rarely reward it outside that sweet spot; treat it as a specialist tool, not a general workhorse.
